## bizOS production health checks

Polls API and web endpoints every 5 minutes. No secrets required for public health URLs.

Defaults:
- API: https://api.bizos.qloudihub.com/api/v1/health
- Web: https://bizos.qloudihub.com/

Override with `BIZOS_API_HEALTH_URL` and `BIZOS_WEB_HEALTH_URL`.
Unhealthy results are emailed via Mailpit or `BIZOS_OPS_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

meta.description: Monitors bizOS production API and web health. Alerts only when unhealthy.
